name: freya-1-comp (example - copy this file before editing)
description: The Linux main computer. Fill in the USB serial number from the B0 inventory before the first real run; the values below are placeholders and the framework will refuse to open a device it cannot identify.

direction_symmetry_counts.rationale: A working figure, not a requirement. Until HW-B4-001 has measured both directions there is nothing authoritative to compare against.

angle_growth_counts.rationale: Whether error grows with angle is the question; this bound only decides when to raise a defect for a human to look at.

endurance_drift_counts.rationale: A trend detector, not a limit. The measured first-to-last-decile difference is the result.

move_timeout_headroom.rationale: A movement that routinely takes more than half its timeout leaves no margin to distinguish a slow movement from a stuck one.

status_latency_ms.rationale: get_status must answer at the same speed whether the sensor is present or missing, so it must be far below an acquisition.

operator_angle_tolerance_deg.rationale: What a human can read off a protractor. Not a property of the mechanism.

rotation_drift_counts.rationale: An absolute bound that does NOT scale with the rotation count. A 100-rotation run that accepts 100x the one-rotation tolerance has no acceptance criterion at all.

notes: THIRTEEN TESTS ARE BLOCKED BY THIS FILE BEING A TEMPLATE, and each one names the field it needs. Fill in `unit.module_id` to unblock HW-B0-006; declare `instruments.multimeter` for HW-B0-008, HW-B4-008 and HW-B7-012; `instruments.oscilloscope` for HW-B0-010; `instruments.thermal_probe` for HW-B11-007; `fixtures.representative_load` for HW-B4-007 and HW-B5-007. The remaining four (HW-B2-006, HW-B2-008, HW-B2-011, HW-B3-004, HW-B6-001) need the test-side diagnostic agent - see test_side_firmware/DEPLOYMENT.md. gear_ratio_servo_to_carousel is ASSUMED to be 1.0 and is one of the things H-002 exists to settle: if the mechanism has a reduction between the ST3215 output shaft and the carousel plate, every angle in the firmware is wrong by that ratio. Do not change it to make a test pass - change it only from a measurement, and set provenance to MEASURED with the run id in notes when you do. slot_count is null so the production value (4) is used; do not put a second copy of it here.
